name: Patient
definition: A person enrolled in the thrombosis study, identified by a unique patient ID and carrying demographics (sex, birthday), a record date, a first-visit date, an admission status and the recorded autoimmune disease diagnosis.
scope: Root entity for per-patient analysis across the Patient, Examination and Laboratory tables.

name: Clinical Examination
definition: One clinical examination event for a patient, recording the examination date, the autoimmune disease diagnosis at that visit, the thrombosis severity grade, observed symptoms, and the antinuclear and anticardiolipin antibody panel.
scope: Per-visit clinical observation stored in the Examination table; a patient may have more than one examination record.

name: Laboratory Test Record
definition: One laboratory test event for a patient on a given date. The table is stored in wide format: every analyte has its own column and most analyte columns are empty on a given row.
scope: Per-test-date laboratory measurement stored in the Laboratory table; a patient may accumulate hundreds of records.

name: Patient Identifier
definition: The numeric ID that uniquely identifies a patient. Patient IDs are large multi-digit integers (observed 2110-5845877), not dense sequence numbers, so they must never be treated as a continuous range.
scope: Used to identify, list and join patients across the Patient, Examination and Laboratory tables.

name: Sex
definition: Recorded sex of the patient, encoded as 'M' or 'F'.
scope: Patient demographic dimension; used both as a cohort filter and as the conditioning variable for sex-specific reference ranges such as uric acid.

name: Birthday
definition: The patient's date of birth, stored as a date (observed 1912-08-28 to 2007-05-28).
scope: Basis for age computation and for birth-year cohort filters.

name: Patient Age
definition: The patient's age in years, derived from the birthday relative to the current date (current year minus birth year, or an equivalent date difference). It is not a stored column.
scope: Derived per-patient attribute used for age thresholds and for 'youngest'/'oldest' comparisons.

name: Admission Status
definition: Whether the patient was admitted to the hospital as an inpatient ('+') or merely followed as an outpatient ('-') for the recorded visit.
scope: Patient-level visit attribute used to separate inpatient from outpatient cohorts.

name: Patient Diagnosis
definition: The autoimmune disease or diseases recorded for a patient in the Patient table, expressed as one or more disease abbreviations joined by commas (for example 'SLE', 'RA', 'APS', 'SLE, APS').
scope: Patient-level diagnosis used for disease cohort filters; absent from the Patient table only for an empty string.

name: Examination Diagnosis
definition: The autoimmune disease or diseases recorded for a patient at a specific examination event in the Examination table, using the same disease abbreviation vocabulary as the patient-level diagnosis.
scope: Visit-level diagnosis used when the question ties a disease to an examination date; frequently empty (331 of 806 rows).

name: Thrombosis Severity
definition: Graded severity of thrombosis recorded at an examination on a 0-3 ordinal scale, where 0 means no thrombosis and non-zero values encode clinical severity grades.
scope: Examination-level thrombosis grading; the workload distinguishes grade 1 as the most serious and grade 2 as severe.

name: Observed Symptom
definition: Free-text clinical symptom description recorded at an examination. It is populated only when the examination carries a non-zero thrombosis grade, so it doubles as a presence/absence signal.
scope: Examination-level textual observation, not a coded diagnosis.

name: Examination Date
definition: The date on which a clinical examination was performed (observed 1989-04-18 to 1998-04-17).
scope: Time dimension for examination-level selection and year filters.

name: Patient Record Date
definition: The date stored on the patient record in the Patient table, used in the workload as the date on which the patient was diagnosed and/or came to the hospital.
scope: Patient-level event date used for year-based patient selection; many patients share the same value because records were entered in batches (97 distinct values for 1022 non-empty records).

name: First Visit Date
definition: The date of the patient's first recorded visit to the hospital (observed 1972-08-02 to 1998-08-28). It is generally earlier than the record date and is often empty.
scope: Patient-level entry date into the study; used for 'came to the hospital after ...' filters.

name: Laboratory Test Date
definition: The date on which a laboratory test record was produced (observed 1981-01-27 to 1999-03-04, no placeholder dates).
scope: Time dimension for laboratory-level analysis and month-over-month or year-over-year comparisons.

name: Antinuclear Antibody (ANA)
definition: Antinuclear antibody titre measured at an examination; reported as a numeric titre where 0 means negative and higher powers of two indicate stronger positivity. A parallel qualitative staining-pattern field is recorded.
scope: Examination-level serology used in connective-tissue-disease assessment.

name: ANA Staining Pattern
definition: Immunofluorescence staining pattern or patterns accompanying the ANA titre, encoded as letters such as S (speckled), P (peripheral), D (diffuse) or N, sometimes combined with commas or periods.
scope: Examination-level qualitative descriptor; not suitable for numeric comparison.

name: Anticardiolipin Antibody
definition: Anticardiolipin antibody concentration measured at an examination, reported separately for the IgG, IgM and IgA isotypes in three parallel columns.
scope: Examination-level serology; the phrase 'anti-Cardiolipin' in analytical questions maps onto the aCL isotype columns.

name: Anti-Sm Antibody
definition: Anti-Smith antibody result from a laboratory record. It is recorded either as a numeric titre or as a textual marker, so a negative result appears in several interchangeable encodings.
scope: Laboratory-level serology; 'normal anti-SM' means a negative result.

name: Uric Acid (UA)
definition: Serum uric acid concentration from a laboratory record. The reference range is sex-specific: the upper normal bound is 8.0 for males and 6.5 for females.
scope: Laboratory analyte compared against a sex-specific upper reference bound.

name: Hematocrit (HCT)
definition: Hematocrit level from a laboratory record; elevated values above the upper reference bound are the abnormal direction used in the workload.
scope: Laboratory analyte compared against an upper reference bound.

name: Red Blood Cell Count (RBC)
definition: Red blood cell count from a laboratory record; low values are the abnormal direction used in the workload.
scope: Laboratory analyte compared against a lower reference bound.

name: Lactate Dehydrogenase (LDH)
definition: Lactate dehydrogenase enzyme activity from a laboratory record; values above the upper reference bound are the abnormal direction used in the workload.
scope: Laboratory analyte compared against an upper reference bound.

name: Prothrombin Time (PT)
definition: Prothrombin time from a laboratory record; values at or above the upper reference bound are the abnormal direction used in the workload.
scope: Laboratory analyte used in coagulation assessment.

name: Immunoglobulin A (IgA)
definition: Serum immunoglobulin A concentration from a laboratory record; a two-sided reference interval applies, so both low and high values count as abnormal.
scope: Laboratory analyte compared against both a lower and an upper reference bound.

name: Total Cholesterol (T-CHO)
definition: Total serum cholesterol from a laboratory record. Change between two test dates is expressed as the relative change between the two measured values.
scope: Laboratory analyte used for month-over-month comparisons.
